questions.q: 9. In a certain code language, TOGETHER" is written as "95", "FUTURE" is written as "88", then how will "FOREVER" be written in that code language ?
questions.s:
9.(a)
Logic:- (Sum of the place value of letters) - 3
TOGETHER :- (20 + 15 + 7 + 5 + 20 + 8 + 5 + 18) - 3 = 98 - 3 = 95
FUTURE :- (6 + 21 + 20 + 21 + 18 + 5) - 3 = 91 - 3 = 88
Similarly,
FOREVER :- (6 + 15 + 18 + 5 + 22 + 5 + 18) - 3 = 89 - 3 = 86
